Folks — adding technical detail for the manifest + on-site validation steps. Copying Claire so their team has the implementation notes.

Technical notes (short):
- release_manifest.tar.gz will contain: images/ (raw tarball), manifests/ (json per image with sha256/sha512), build_metadata.json (builder hostname, timestamp), provenance.log (CI run ids).
- We will sign the tar with the redwood-prod-2024 key and also create an armored signature release_manifest.tar.gz.sig. The signature will be verified by: gpg --verify release_manifest.tar.gz.sig release_manifest.tar.gz
- For additional assurance we will include signed SHA512 checksums in checksums.sha512.asc (detached armored signature).

On-site operator checklist (validation subset):
1) Inspect external seal tags for tamper evidence; log seal ID.
2) Verify printed manifest matches filenames and sizes on media (use checksum tool we provide).
3) Verify signature & thumbprint: compare redwood-prod-2024 x509 thumbprint to the value in artifact_provenance.xlsx. If mismatch -> quarantine and call Redwood ops.
4) Boot device in isolated network; do not connect to corporate network. Use the provided jump host for activation.

Logistics: BlackShip — please confirm courier ETA and whether seals will be photographed as part of pickup. Claire — once BlackShip confirms pickup time I will upload the signed artifacts to the secure drive and provide checksums.

-Karthik
